dataset: HariMaga lost government documents routing v1

police.nearest_station_rule: For a lost NIC, the Department for Registration of Persons says to report the loss immediately to the nearest police station. Lost driving-licence replacement also requires a copy of the police complaint. A lost/stolen passport in Sri Lanka should be reported to the local police station as soon as possible.
police.important_note: 119 is for emergencies. A routine lost-document report should normally be made to the relevant/nearest police station. Tell IGP is an official online police complaint route, but HariMaga must not claim that an online submission automatically replaces a police complaint copy required by DRP, DMT or Immigration.

national_identity_card.label: National Identity Card (NIC)
steps: Report the lost NIC immediately to the nearest police station.
Apply for a replacement NIC through the relevant certifying officer.
For a non-estate resident, the application is forwarded through the Grama Niladhari and countersigned by the Divisional Secretary.
Keep the police report/complaint details and supporting identity/civil documents required by DRP.

driving_licence.label: Driving Licence
steps: Lodge a complaint about the lost driving licence with the police.
For a duplicate licence, DMT requires a copy of the police complaint lodged within 6 months of the loss.
Prepare the National Identity Card or a valid passport carrying the NIC number.
Contact the DMT Driving Licence Section / Werahera for the replacement process.

passport.label: Sri Lankan Passport
steps: If the passport is lost or stolen in Sri Lanka, make a complaint to the local police station as soon as possible.
Inform the Department of Immigration and Emigration using the official lost/stolen passport contact route.
The police transmits complaint details to Immigration for cancellation of the lost/stolen passport.
Once reported lost/stolen and cancelled, do not use the old passport even if it is later found.
For a replacement passport, the original police complaint is among the required documents.

other_government_document.label: Other government-issued document
other_government_document.authority: Relevant issuing authority + Sri Lanka Police
steps: Report the loss to the relevant/nearest police station when a police record is required or the document can be misused.
Use only that authority's verified replacement procedure and contact details.
